site.name: Onchain Mechanism Lab
site.tagline: Put abstract rules on the lab bench and watch them work.
site.educationNotice: All assets are virtual credits for education only.

nav.toolsDescription: These tools appear when the journey reaches them, or you can open them directly here.
nav.flowDescription: After several mechanisms, inspect how value and risk cross boundaries.
nav.labDescription: Leave the lesson prompts and freely change or break the mechanism.
nav.challengeDescription: Use cross-module questions to test whether the boundaries really hold.
nav.glossaryDescription: Look up unfamiliar terms and return to the related lesson.
nav.journalDescription: Save experiment states, compare outcomes, and write your explanation.
